title: Brain Metastases Segmentation for BraTS 2026 Task 1: A Multi-Architecture Comparison
mechanism: Head-to-head region-based vs label-based training on the same model with grouped CV, plus pitfalls in region-to-label reconstruction and ensembling.
evidence: R (read): Primus region vs label: ET DSC 0.713 vs 0.710, WT 0.680 vs 0.683, RC 0.566 vs 0.531, TC 0.400 vs 0.742 from a wrong region write order. Lesion F1 unrelated to DSC ranking (ResEncL 0.452 vs Primus 0.052); probability averaging kept the weaker model's lesion F1.
adaptation: Write outer region before inner in the region head and check pixel counts vs softmax; report component-level crack recall beside IoU and check whether 5-seed averaging drops small cracks one seed finds.
min_experiment: No separate training: in the region-head run, compare write orders and per-seed vs ensemble component recall (crack components >=20 px and <20 px); flag if ensemble component recall < best single seed.
